prompt: My project is set up in team mode and I want opencode-coder to generate or update AGENTS.md and the standard topic docs. Some topics like releases are fully handled by an installed skill and I do not want hollow docs for those. Walk me through what should be created versus what should just route to skills.
assertions: Treats AGENTS as a routing table rather than a handbook
Creates standard docs only when they contain real project-specific guidance
Routes skill-only topics to reusable skills instead of creating hollow docs
Uses team-mode file locations like docs/ and root AGENTS.md
Includes verification of links or paths or stale references before completion
